## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, the change and what users will observe.

## Validation

List the commands/results and material checks you could not perform. Include
browser/layout evidence for UI changes; use synthetic, redacted data.

## Security and compatibility impact

Describe any effect on authentication, authorization, admission, evidence,
network reach, dependencies, migrations or deployment. Link relevant private
security coordination without disclosing exploit details or credentials.
